1, We do not have routers, just focus on Marvell based managed switches.
2, It is OK to just offer PCBA with your enclosure design, actually we think this is the best solution.

4, it is fine to provide the products/PCBA under your brand.
5, high and low temperature tolerance: this is OK, our industrial models can stand in -40~75℃, this has been tested and proven for numerous times.
With those general rules, let’s move on to detailed discussion.
Thank you.

Thank you, Alan. I will review the documents and return you.

May be Simon has already told you, but I want to make sure you got the specification that we need below.

We collaborate closely with defense companies in Turkey on various communication projects. They are currently seeking rugged routers and switches that offer the same functionality as commercial products but are facing challenges in finding models that meet their ruggedization requirements.

We are planning to produce rugged L2/L3 switches and routers by sourcing readily available router and switch PCBAs. If possible, Netaş can also handle the mechanical design of these products to ensure compliance with environmental and compatibility standards. Additionally, obtaining the source codes or SDKs of these devices would be highly beneficial for us and our customers to enable product customization.

Below, you can see the network, interface, and environmental requirements. Note that not all environmental specifications are mandatory, but some—such as high and low temperature tolerance—may be of interest.
The goal would be to release these products under the Netaş brand. The market size is estimated at 300-400 per year at the begining.

Dear Vendor,



We hope you are doing well.



As FindLight continues to grow in popularity among professionals in photonics and advanced manufacturing, we are making a few updates to improve our vendor experience and ensure sustainable growth for the platform.



Starting December 1, 2025, we will be discontinuing the Basic (free) plan.


However, we are pleased to let you know that your existing Freemium account will remain active beyond December 1 and you can continue managing your products and receiving sales inquiries. Moreover, you can continue adding up to 15 products in your account unitl Dec 1.

Increased exposure in search results on FindLight, Google, and other search engines






Access to direct inquiries and analytics






Priority customer support and marketing features on banners and top category positions







We’re excited about the continued growth of the FindLight community and look forward to helping you reach an even broader audience.



View Vendor Plans <https://www.findlight.net/pricing >



Thank you for being part of the FindLight network, your partnership is what makes this platform thrive.



Warm regards,


The FindLight Team
